digest.component_or_area: local developer gates and Bedrock LLM provider configuration
propositions: Local developer gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must be configured to resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles using REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE before production cutover to validate end-to-end behavior
All gate runs must resolve exclusively to Bedrock inference profiles (zero direct-Anthropic calls) and produce parseable, validated structured verdicts without provider-driven degradation
Prompt caching must demonstrably engage on the Bedrock path with nonzero cache_read_tokens across multiple calls, not write-only behavior
Configuration must be reversible and documented in docs/local-dev-env.md such that a developer can opt-in and revert to Anthropic with environment variables alone
No changes to infra/, src/ behavior, or gate semantics are expected; if behavioral changes emerge they warrant separate tickets
